title: Adapting Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) for Chinese Americans
brief_summary: The goals of this study were to a) test whether cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is effective in treating depressed Chinese Americans, b) to develop and test the effectiveness of culturally adapt CBT, and c) to test the differential outcomes of the two treatments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* depression, Chinese American

Exclusion Criteria:

* bipolar, psychotic disorder, primary substance abuse problem, severe medical conditions that induce depression
